record.question: Myopia is defined as:
options: Light focuses in front of the retina
Equal focusing on retina and lens
record.explanation: Answer B: Light focuses in front of the retina. Myopia focuses distant images in front of the retina. Reference: https://www.nei.nih.gov/learn-about-eye-health/eye-conditions-and-diseases/nearsightedness-myopia. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
